name: agent-core
description: The Lua core as one component (docs/KERNEL.md, A2.1): wa-host's vendored Lua 5.4 interpreter, every `host.*` reached through the single wa:kernel/host.call import, so one agent turn runs inside the sandbox instead of in the node process. The node picks it up with WA_AGENT_CORE_WASM, else `<components dir>/agent-core.wasm`; the `agent_core` feature (docs/FEATURES.md) is what says whether the node routes turns to it.
